description: fr inline disambiguation (chunk/immunize/add/filter/ignore_spelling) then inline grammar rules (chunk tokens, antipatterns on disambiguated sentences)

args.dxml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rules lang="fr">
<rule id="D_CHUNK" name="D_CHUNK"><pattern><token postag="D .*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="N .*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="addchunk"><wd pos="B-NP-singular"/><wd pos="I-NP-singular"/></disambig></rule>
<rule id="D_IMM" name="D_IMM"><pattern><token postag="J .*" postag_regexp="yes"/><token postag="N .*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="immunize"/></rule>
<rule id="D_ADD" name="D_ADD"><pattern><token postag="V .*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="add"><wd lemma="ADDV" pos="XV"/></disambig></rule>
<rule id="D_FILT" name="D_FILT"><pattern><token postag="N .*" postag_regexp="yes"/></pattern><disambig action="filter" postag="N .*"/></rule>
<rule id="D_SPELL" name="D_SPELL"><pattern><token postag="D .*" postag_regexp="yes"/><marker><token postag="N .*" postag_regexp="yes"/></marker></pattern><disambig action="ignore_spelling"/></rule>
</rules>
